title: Picture Study
note: Each picture is a Human Atlas render.

images.title: Heart Chambers and Vessels
images.caption: Only the blood-filled chambers and the great vessels are shown. The right side of the heart is on the left of the picture in the front view.
images.alt: The heart chambers and great vessels in separate colours, shown in 3D or in sections.

images.title: Heart Valves
images.caption: The two semilunar valves have three cusps each. The two atrioventricular valves have cords that hold their flaps. The heart is shown as a faint ghost.
images.alt: The four heart valves in separate colours inside a faint outline of the heart.

images.title: Air Passages
images.caption: Air passes from the throat down to the bronchi. The atlas has no lung model, so only the air passages are shown.
images.alt: The throat muscles, voice box, windpipe and bronchial tree in separate colours, shown in 3D or in sections.

images.title: Larynx (Laryngeal Skeleton)
images.caption: The larynx is built from cartilages held together by membranes and ligaments. The hyoid bone sits above it and the trachea starts below the cricoid cartilage. The vocal folds are inside, so they show in the back view and the sections.
images.alt: The hyoid bone, epiglottis, thyroid, cricoid, arytenoid and corniculate cartilages, the thyrohyoid membrane, cricothyroid ligament, vocal folds and trachea in separate colours, shown in 3D or in sections.

images.title: Brain Lobes
images.caption: The cerebrum has four lobes. The cerebellum sits below and behind it. The brainstem leads down to the spinal cord. In the sections the grey areas are white matter.
images.alt: The brain lobes, cerebellum and brainstem in separate colours, shown in 3D or in sections.

images.title: Digestive Organs
images.caption: Only the digestive organs are shown. The liver is left out so the other organs can be seen.
images.alt: The esophagus, stomach, pancreas, gallbladder, small intestine and large intestine in separate colours, shown in 3D or in sections.

images.title: Small Intestine Segments
images.caption: The small intestine has three segments. The duodenum is the short first part. The jejunum comes next and the ileum is last.
images.alt: The duodenum, jejunum and ileum in separate colours, shown in 3D or in sections.

images.title: Large Intestine Segments
images.caption: In the 3D view the chyme travels through the segments in order. It starts at the cecum and ends at the rectum.
images.alt: The large intestine with each segment in its own colour, shown in 3D with moving chyme or in sections.

images.title: Urinary Organs
images.caption: Urine is made in the kidneys and carried by the ureters to the bladder. The urethra carries it out of the body. The atlas has no kidney interior, so the cortex, medulla and pelvis are not shown.
images.alt: The kidneys, ureters, urinary bladder and urethra in separate colours, shown in 3D or in sections.
